messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PAGER — High error rate (429) for tenant 'pegasus' on vpc-dedicated-pool-3. Priority: P1. Paging oncall.
oncall-maya: on it. joining channel. first pass: how widespread? customer report says ~30% of requests failing with 429s since 10:03 UTC.
sre-julia: logs show surge of short-lived spikes from IP range 34.120.x.x hitting /v1/generate on pool-3, token usage up x3, KV cache hit drops. likely noisy tenant or misrouted clients.
account-amy: just got a slack DM from Pegasus infra: they saw a sudden burst from a new job after a rollout. They're asking for emergency relief while they throttle.
platform-ops: current pool has autoscale maxed and queueing to prevent overload. We can cut traffic via routing rules to their dedicated backup pool (pegasus-backup) for 10m while they patch.
oncall-maya: can we do a rate-bridge (route 50% to backup) instead of a full lift? want to avoid changing quotas.
infra-nick: we have a prebuilt routing policy 'rate-bridge' in /ops/routing that can split per-tenant by weight. I can apply a 60/40 split to reduce pressure on pool-3. will run command shortly.
platform-ops: runbook step: 1) apply temporary split 2) monitor latency & 429 rate 3) if stable, keep and request customer to rollback offending job 4) consider one-off contract override if needed.
platform-ops: applying: 
```
opsctl routing apply --tenant pegasus --from pool-3 --to pegasus-backup --weight 40 --reason "emergency rate relay"
```
platform-ops: done — 40% of new connections routed to pegasus-backup. watch metrics.
sre-julia: seeing immediate drop in 429 rate on pool-3 from 32% -> 12% in the last 60s. backup pool showing increased CPU/VRAM but within capacity.
customer-pegasus-eng: thanks — we pushed a rollback and killed the runaway job. will confirm in a minute.
oncall-maya: good. can we keep the bridge for 15 minutes while they validate? also need to log as a temporary mitigation for postmortem.
platform-ops: yes, retention note attached. I annotated incident runbook and flagged this as "bridge-mitigation". TTL 15m set.
account-amy: FYI Pegasus asked if we can waive any overage charges during this emergency — they claim traffic was internal tester misuse. I can escalate to biz ops but need SRE signoff to keep bridge longer than 30m.
sre-julia: technically this is under our emergency policy for tenant protection. If backup pool incurs cost, we can eat for first 30m, escalate after.
infra-nick: small config note: the KV cache warms slower on backup since it's a separate pool, expect a small temporary latency bump for routed requests. we should warn the customer.
customer-pegasus-eng: saw 2 retries succeed. latency slightly higher but acceptable. we'll run full regression and confirm rollback success.
oncall-maya: monitoring shows 429s now at 1.8% cluster-wide for pegasus, down from 32%. request we begin handoff in 10m if stable.
sre-julia: start preparing mitigation summary for postmortem: timeline, routing change, metrics, customer actions, cost implication, decision tree for contract override.
platform-ops: note: no code deploys required on our side. rollback was customer-triggered. closing note: bridge TTL will expire at +15m automatically, will remove routes unless extended.
oncall-maya: if customer requests extension, tag with #contract-override and @account-amy will drive billing approval.
customer-pegasus-eng: confirmed rollback successful, spike stopped. please remove routing split at your convenience after 10m.
oncall-maya: acknowledged. will start handback in 10m if steady.
platform-ops: removing routing split now per request: 
```
opsctl routing remove-split --tenant pegasus --from pool-3 --to pegasus-backup
```
platform-ops: split removed. verifying.
sre-julia: 429s holding at ~0.5% for the tenant, latencies normalizing. closing oncall handback to customer.
oncall-maya: handback: oncall -> customer confirmed, mitigation lifted. opening incident ticket INC-2026-092-pegasus for follow-up postmortem and billing review.
account-amy: will open billing exception request and coordinate with Pegasus for a goodwill credit if appropriate.
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — P1 cleared. responder: oncall-maya. Please attach timeline and findings to INC-2026-092-pegasus for review. :white_check_mark:
